question: ΔPQR is a right angled triangle. ∠Q = 90 degree, PQ = 5 cm, QR = 12 cm. What is the value of cot P - tan R ?
solution:
Given:

ΔPQR is right-angled at Q

⇒ Cot P = 5/12

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bf4a9f9370a8cfb1851ad1b23a09d9017b5d6fe24e530780b9bd24a3fea7c30.png] 

Cot P = Adjacent/Opposite = QP/RQ = 5/12

Tan R = PQ/QR = 5/12

cot P - tan R = 5/12 - 5/12 = 0

∴ The correct answer is 0.
